topics.title: Pythagorean Theorem
topics.short: In a right triangle, the square on the longest side equals the sum of the squares on the other two.
topics.simple: For any right-angled triangle with shorter sides $a$ and $b$ and longest side $c$, $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.

relations.note: The length of a vector follows from it.

topics.title: Dot Product
topics.short: Multiplying two vectors to get a number that measures how much they point the same way.
topics.simple: The dot product of two arrows is large when they point the same way, zero when they are perpendicular, and negative when they point apart.
